secrets.name: MANUS_JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign/verify session JWT cookies (jose). A dev placeholder is in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real value for production.

secrets.name: MANUS_OAUTH_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus platform OAuth API base URL (for token exchange / user info). Obtain from the Manus platform dashboard.

secrets.name: MANUS_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Manus project/app ID used for OAuth login flow. Obtain from the Manus platform dashboard.

secrets.name: MANUS_OAUTH_PORTAL_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth portal URL (where the browser is redirected to log in). Obtain from the Manus platform dashboard.

secrets.name: MANUS_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL (storage, data API, heartbeat, LLM, etc.). Obtain from the Manus platform dashboard.

secrets.name: MANUS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API key (server-side, bearer token). Obtain from the Manus platform dashboard.

secrets.name: MANUS_API_BROWSER_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge browser API key (exposed to the client for public API calls). Obtain from the Manus platform dashboard.

secrets.name: OWNER_OPEN_ID
secrets.description: Optional: the owner's Manus openId — automatically assigned the 'admin' role on login.
